# Public synthetic SSO fixture

Files under `import/` are generated by `scripts/sso_fixture.py` for the isolated Keycloak OIDC/SAML acceptance environment. Any names, accounts, passwords, client secrets or realm settings in this directory are public synthetic test data, never production credentials.

Only enable these fixtures through the explicitly named `*-qa` Compose project and `-SsoQaFixture` option described in `docs/sso-validation.md`. Do not import the realms into a real organization's Identity Provider, reuse their credentials, or expose the QA broker publicly. Normal Suite startup does not enable the fixture profile.

Regenerate with the repository fixture script when the scenario changes. Keep private customer realm exports, private signing keys and real tokens out of this directory.
